record.label: Teacher-forced innovation capacity below 1e-8
record.summary: On fixed observer_fit 160/40 evidence, the repaired-Q24 baseline is 9.1654788988087e-8, autonomous local-plus-transport is 4.3568594510510543e-8, and teacher-forced innovation reaches 8.77026611809935e-9. A separate fixed-35 tangent study reaches 7.879932501341983e-9 teacher-forced but 3.845796988863838e-8 autonomous. This proves signal capacity only; it supplies no legal recursive state provider.
record.terminal_criterion: Capacity-only boundary: retain the <1e-8 teacher-forced result without treating target residuals as an autonomous deployment input.
